resets.asserted_meaning: Sets data_out to zero; temp_data is not reset.

ports.name: data_in
ports.role: Parallel input word captured into temp_data while load is high.

ports.name: load
ports.role: Four-state load enable for temp_data capture and the selected operation on the previous temp_data value.

ports.name: shift_en
ports.role: Selects left, logical-right, arithmetic-left, or explicit sign-preserving right shift for selector values 00 through 11.

ports.name: reset
ports.role: Active-high synchronous data_out reset; does not clear temp_data.

ports.name: data_out
ports.role: Registered transformed previous temp_data; holds when load is low.

declared_unknowns.description: temp_data is not initialized or reset; the first loaded operation uses its unknown prior value. data_out is unknown until a rising edge with reset asserted or a defined assignment.

Arithmetic left shift on the unsigned packed register is modeled as a logical left shift. Directed X-valued load and shift selector checks exercise procedural-if and case behavior; Z selector behavior is not separately exercised.
Clock and reset SystemC ports use bool and are modeled only for binary 0/1 levels; X/Z on clock or reset is outside the modeled verification scope.
